story.titleZh: 阿斯顿马丁车手：满意表现但直道损失圈速
story.summaryZh: 阿斯顿马丁F1车手表示对周五表现和赛车平衡满意，但在直道上损失大量圈速，可能让正赛变得困难。

media.altZh: 阿斯顿马丁车手：满意表现但直道损失圈速

story.originalTitle: "I was happy with my performance and with the overall balance of the car today compared to yesterday. We are losing a lot of lap time on the straights...
story.summaryEn:
"I was happy with my performance and with the overall balance of the car today compared to yesterday. We are losing a lot of lap time on the straights, and so I think it will make the race difficult for us."
Debrief our Friday at the #AzerbaijanGP: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/races/2026-azerbaijan-gp
detailZh:
“我对自己的表现以及今天赛车相比昨天的整体平衡感到满意。我们在直道上损失了很多圈速，所以我认为这会让我们的正赛变得困难。”
回顾我们在#阿塞拜疆大奖赛的周五：https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/races/2026-azerbaijan-gp
detailEn:
"I was happy with my performance and with the overall balance of the car today compared to yesterday. We are losing a lot of lap time on the straights, and so I think it will make the race difficult for us."
Debrief our Friday at the #AzerbaijanGP: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/races/2026-azerbaijan-gp
keyPointsZh: 该表态发布于阿塞拜疆大奖赛周五练习之后，车队发布了周五总结
keyPointsEn: The comments came after Friday practice at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, with the team publishing a Friday debrief

bodyZh: 阿斯顿马丁F1车手表示对周五表现和赛车平衡满意，但在直道上损失大量圈速，可能让正赛变得困难。

relatedItems.originalTitle: Our #AzerbaijanGP comes to an early end. Lance was asked to stop the car on track due to a suspected water pressure issue, with Fernando retiring afte...
relatedItems.summaryEn:
Our #AzerbaijanGP comes to an early end.
Lance was asked to stop the car on track due to a suspected water pressure issue, with Fernando retiring after losing speed on the straights.
The team are investigating both issues.
detailZh:
我们的阿塞拜疆大奖赛提前结束了。
由于疑似水压问题，斯特罗尔被要求将赛车停在赛道上，而阿隆索则因在直道上失去速度而退赛。
车队正在调查这两个问题。
detailEn:
Our #AzerbaijanGP comes to an early end.
Lance was asked to stop the car on track due to a suspected water pressure issue, with Fernando retiring after losing speed on the straights.
The team are investigating both issues.
keyPointsZh: 斯特罗尔被要求将车停在赛道上，疑似水压问题。
阿隆索退赛的原因是在直道上损失了速度。
车队表示正在对两起退赛的原因展开调查。
keyPointsEn: Lance Stroll was asked to stop the car on track due to a suspected water pressure issue.
Fernando Alonso retired after losing speed on the straights.
The team said they are investigating both issues.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Lance has stopped on track bringing his #AzerbaijanGP to an end. The team are investigating the issue.

detailEn: Lance has stopped on track bringing his #AzerbaijanGP to an end. The team are investigating the issue.
